data.name: Ecclesiastes Mistress Of Souls
data.detailed_description:
Step into the world of ECCLESIASTES: Mistress of Souls, a fast-paced, story-driven fighting game that blends open-world exploration with intense 1v1 combat. Players can freely traverse dark, war-torn realms, battle hordes of enemies in open zones, and face powerful nemeses in dramatic duel arenas. Every encounter tests skill, timing, and mastery of unique fighting styles


You play as ECCLESIASTES initially, a fierce warrior consumed by vengeance—her quest: to defeat the three nemeses who once betrayed her and shattered her soul. To face them, she must conquer their warlords, harvest Soul Stones, and summon each nemesis for a sacred duel.
 Every victory binds her fallen foes to her will—transforming them into disciples who now fight by her side. Through cinematic cutscenes and in-game dialogue, the narrative unravels themes of power, redemption, and the price of control over the souls of others

  • Dual Combat Systems: Experience dynamic open-world skirmishes and 1v1 arena battles with fluid, skill-based combat mechanics.

  • Soul Slave System: Defeat nemeses to enslave their spirits and unlock them as playable disciples.

  • Story-Rich Experience: Discover lore through cutscenes, in-game dialogue, and hidden world events.

  • Exploration & Progression: Collect Soul Stones, upgrade combat abilities, and unlock new fighting techniques.

  • Multiple Battle Styles: Master Ecclesiastes’ evolving powers or command her growing army of fallen warriors.


Advance through a dark narrative by conquering enemies and absorbing their souls. Defeating each nemesis expands your roster and fighting depth, offering new moves, strategies, and story perspectives. As Ecclesiastes grows stronger, so does the weight of her vengeance—and the moral decay it brings

data.short_description: ECCLESIASTES, Mistress of Souls is an upcoming fighting game based on the comic book series by Leon C.L.Dawes. A new fighting game, That deals in magic , spells,Djinn and the Nephilim!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8.1 64-bit or Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100T or AMD FX 6100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 or AMD R7 260x
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 8.1 64-bit or Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3570K or AMD Ryzen 3 1300x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 980 or AMD R9 290X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Contains fantasy violence and mild sexual themes. No explicit sexual acts are depicted.
